{{Top|leg}}
'''Magnetic rings''' were components integral to the function of the [[Micro-grenade launcher/Legends|micro-grenade launcher]]. When the weapon was fired, the magnetic rings accelerated the [[Micro-grenade/Legends|micro-grenades]] to high velocities, launching them from the [[Barrel/Legends|barrel]]. The rings degraded after constant use, which could cause a grenade to jam in the barrel. Replacing the rings was recommended while perfoming maintenance on the weapon.<ref name="GFT">''[[Gundark's Fantastic Technology: Personal Gear]]''</ref>
